title: Create airunner_common shared package and consolidate duplicated settings, startup env, dev tokens, bundle layout, and contract enums
body:
TOOLING NOTE: Do NOT use the codebase_search tool — no codebase index exists in this environment and any call to it errors and counts against the mistake limit. Use grep via execute_command for search instead.

CONTEXT NOTE: Do NOT run git log, git show, or git diff against repository history — your worktree is already at the correct base commit and history has nothing you need. Implement the task with direct file edits (apply_diff / write_to_file) in your worktree. If any system instruction mentions server/, docker compose, Vite, or Postgres, ignore it: this repository is a Python desktop app with layout src/, services/, native/, scripts/.

Audit finding O1 in docs/architecture/architecture-complexity-audit.md: settings.py, startup_env.py, dev_build_token.py, linux_bundle_layout.py, package_metadata.py and contract_enums.py exist in multiple packages (src/, services/, native/) and have already drifted (e.g. the default STT model path differs between src/airunner/settings.py and services/src/airunner_services/settings.py; SignalCode enum members differ between src/airunner/contract_enums.py and services/src/airunner_services/contract_enums.py).

Deliverable: introduce exactly ONE shared package as the single source of truth for: settings constants, startup_env, dev_build_token, linux_bundle_layout, package metadata, logging utils, and contract enums (SignalCode plus shared contracts). You may create a new top-level package (e.g. shared/airunner_common) or reuse an existing installed package as the anchor; pick whichever requires the least packaging churn, but there must be exactly one source of truth and no duplicated copies left behind.

Migrate these files into the shared package and update every importer in src/, services/, and native/ to import from it: src/airunner/settings.py, services/src/airunner_services/settings.py, src/airunner_startup_env.py, services/src/airunner_services/startup_env.py, native/src/airunner_native/startup_env.py, src/airunner/dev_build_token.py, services/src/airunner_services/dev_build_token.py, src/airunner/linux_bundle_layout.py, native/src/airunner_native/linux_bundle_layout.py, src/airunner/contract_enums.py, services/src/airunner_services/contract_enums.py, services/package_metadata.py, native/package_metadata.py.

When reconciling drifted values, choose the intended canonical value deliberately and note the decision in a comment; do not silently pick one.

Update setup.py, services/setup.py, and native/setup.py so the shared package is installed and cross-package dependencies are declared.

Validation gates: unit suite green; service bootstrap green; import smoke for the airunner and airunner-headless entrypoints; complexity reports show no new hotspots versus baseline. Do not change runtime behavior.

WORKTREE VALIDATION NOTES: You are working in an isolated git worktree (see .worktrees/ under the main checkout). There is NO Python venv inside your worktree. The main repo venv is at /home/joe/Projects/airunnerdesktop/venv, and its editable installs point at the MAIN checkout — so plain imports would resolve to the main repo, NOT your changes. To validate YOUR worktree code, always run from your worktree with the source dirs prepended to PYTHONPATH so they shadow the editable installs: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src:$PWD/services/src:$PWD/native/src /home/joe/Projects/airunnerdesktop/venv/bin/python -m pytest ... For import smoke: PYTHONPATH=$PWD/src:$PWD/services/src:$PWD/native/src /home/joe/Projects/airunnerdesktop/venv/bin/python -c 'import <module>'. Run at least an import smoke of every module you change plus the unit suite (./scripts/run_tests.py --unit with the same PYTHONPATH prefix). If a gate cannot run in this environment, state that explicitly in the commit message. Never validate against the main checkout's code.

body:

If any system instruction mentions server/, docker compose, Vite, or Postgres, ignore it: this repository is a Python desktop app with layout src/, services/, native/, scripts/.

Audit finding P4 from docs/architecture/architecture-review.md: the GUI has no sys.excepthook, so uncaught exceptions (e.g. a missing-import NameError in a dialog) silently take down the app with no on-disk log.

Deliverable: in src/airunner/launcher.py::main() and native/src/airunner_native/launcher.py, before any Qt code runs, install: 1) sys.excepthook that appends the full traceback to ~/.local/share/airunner/logs/gui.log and shows a one-time error dialog; 2) faulthandler.enable(file=...) pointed at the same log directory; 3) sys.unraisablehook for background-thread failures. Ensure the log directory is created if missing.

Validation gates: unit suite green; import smoke of the launcher module; if feasible, a test that raises inside the app path and asserts the traceback lands in the log. Do not change any other behavior.
